title: pyrus verruculosa
intro: Pyrus verruculosa, commonly known as the rough-leaved pear, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Pyrus verruculosa include its ability to treat various conditions, such as arthritis, gastrointestinal disorders, and respiratory infections.
